functions.name: to_upper
functions.description: Convert input string to upper case.

functions.name: to_lower
functions.description: Convert input string to lower case.

functions.name: trim
functions.description: Remove leading and trailing whitespace from input.

functions.name: slugify
functions.description: Convert input string to a URL-friendly slug (lowercase, hyphens, ASCII).

functions.name: truncate
functions.description: Truncate input to a maximum length, optionally appending an ellipsis.

params.name: maxLength
params.description: Maximum number of characters to keep.

functions.name: replace
functions.description: Replace all occurrences of a substring (or regex) in the input.

params.name: find
params.description: Pattern to find (literal string or regex source).

params.name: regex
params.description: When true, treat `find` as a regular expression.

functions.name: template_render
functions.description: Render a Mustache-style template using upstream object as context. {{var}} placeholders.

functions.name: markdown_to_text
functions.description: Strip Markdown formatting and return plain text.

functions.name: extract_text_between
functions.description: Extract substring between a start and end delimiter (first match).

functions.name: concat
functions.description: Concatenate the upstream input with an additional string.

functions.name: add
functions.description: Add a number to the upstream numeric input.

functions.name: subtract
functions.description: Subtract a number from the upstream numeric input.

functions.name: multiply
functions.description: Multiply the upstream numeric input by a value.

functions.name: divide
functions.description: Divide the upstream numeric input by a value.

functions.name: round
functions.description: Round the upstream numeric input to a given number of decimal places.

functions.name: clamp
functions.description: Clamp the upstream numeric input between min and max.

functions.name: percent
functions.description: Convert a fraction (0..1) to a percent string with optional precision.

functions.name: sum_array
functions.description: Sum a numeric array provided as the upstream input.

functions.name: json_parse
functions.description: Parse the upstream string input as JSON.

functions.name: json_stringify
functions.description: Stringify the upstream input as JSON, optionally pretty-printed.

functions.name: csv_parse
functions.description: Parse the upstream CSV string into a 2-D array of strings.

functions.name: csv_to_json
functions.description: Parse the upstream CSV string into an array of objects keyed by the header row.

functions.name: yaml_parse
functions.description: Parse the upstream YAML string into a JS value (subset: scalars, mappings, sequences).

functions.name: url_parse
functions.description: Parse the upstream URL string into { protocol, host, pathname, query, hash }.

functions.name: regex_match
functions.description: Return the first regex match (or null) of the pattern against the upstream input.

functions.name: regex_extract_all
functions.description: Return all regex matches of the pattern against the upstream input as an array of strings.

functions.name: date_parse_iso
functions.description: Parse the upstream string as an ISO-8601 date; returns epoch milliseconds.

functions.name: date_format
functions.description: Format an upstream epoch (ms) or ISO string using a token pattern (yyyy, MM, dd, HH, mm, ss).

functions.name: number_format
functions.description: Format the upstream number with locale separators and optional fixed decimals.

functions.name: currency_cad
functions.description: Format the upstream number as Canadian-dollar currency.

functions.name: json_pretty
functions.description: Pretty-print the upstream value (or JSON string) with 2-space indentation.

functions.name: markdown_table
functions.description: Format an upstream array of objects as a Markdown pipe table.

params.name: columns
params.description: Optional ordered column names. Defaults to keys of the first row.

functions.name: wrap_code_fence
functions.description: Wrap the upstream string in a Markdown fenced code block.

functions.name: title_case
functions.description: Convert the upstream string to title case (English heuristics, preserves all-caps words).

functions.name: kebab_case
functions.description: Convert the upstream string to kebab-case.

functions.name: snake_case
functions.description: Convert the upstream string to snake_case.

functions.name: equals
functions.description: Branch when the upstream input equals the comparison value (strict equality).

functions.name: not_equals
functions.description: Branch when the upstream input does not equal the comparison value.

functions.name: contains
functions.description: Branch when the upstream string contains the substring.

functions.name: starts_with
functions.description: Branch when the upstream string starts with the prefix.

functions.name: regex_test
functions.description: Branch when a regex pattern matches the upstream string.

functions.name: gt
functions.description: Branch when the upstream number is greater than the threshold.

functions.name: lt
functions.description: Branch when the upstream number is less than the threshold.

functions.name: between
functions.description: Branch when the upstream number is between min and max (inclusive).
